name: Fred Meyer Grocery Distribution Center Puyallup WA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance off the SW signalized intersection on Valley Ave NW; the drop yard is fully fenced off from the public road and adjacent car lots by a landscaped buffer, and a yard-jockey/spotter truck is visible working the drop yard (controlled operation).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth positively visible from satellite or Street View; the check-in point is set back from the public road behind a tree/landscape buffer so it cannot be confirmed from available imagery. Marked false on visible evidence and flagged for review.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the rule (gate present, no visible guard shack); could flip to false if a setback guard booth exists at the internal checkpoint.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved truck court between the gate and the dock faces gives ample internal queue room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal approach from the gate to the docks can hold well more than 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and large internal truck court provide room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock face along the entire south wall of the main building (~50-60 doors) plus a second dock bank on the west face of the second building; total well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large dedicated trailer drop yard south/between the two buildings, hundreds of trailers in rows (50+ band).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on different building faces (main south wall + second building west face) suggest separate ship/receive clusters; inferred, flagged.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two large connected DC buildings sharing one fenced truck court / drop yard = campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: A through rail corridor (BNSF/Tacoma line) runs along the east edge of the property but no spur enters either building; not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Tacoma-Puyallup metro industrial fabric, dense surrounding development (dealerships, warehouses, retail) = Urban.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1 inbound from the entrance geometry; not separately countable from imagery.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated 1 outbound; entry and exit share the same gate point.
